metadata.name: Google Gmail
metadata.description: Integration with Google Gmail API to manage emails, threads, drafts, and labels.
metadata.author: Nod8

metadata.label: List Messages
metadata.description: Lists messages in the user's mailbox.

query.description: Only return messages matching the specified query. Supports the same query format as the Gmail search box.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of messages to return. Default is 100.

labelIds.description: Comma-separated list of label IDs. Only return messages with these labels.
